rongmei.title: Babylon bang suna bam mei guai

lines: 1. Babylon bang suna bam mei guai
Kapma zion ram ta phang zau lo,
Rianra mei zaengthaek khang Ravguangc ta ning na kap e
Ntao mu suaihiam lou di tho.
Zaeng thaek khang zai lou o ]2
Ning tou na Ravguangc ta kao bam e.
2. Panti puanczing duidai ruh khou hei
Tingmik thui ai rui ningna huai e
Tingkao ram guang tang khang neihla na nangta ning e.
Zianmei guay lung nipui ram tei.
Neila mei zion lu ]2
Suan na Raguangh ta thuan ku dikho.
3. Kandi ryanra ramc khou ruan tat na
Kagan thui Gumeipu ta ning e,
Rianra mei khang na jingpui kandi khou bam san khou
He araguangh khuan ngam mak ge.
Nang ram than khou lung khang, ]2
Ning na kandi hei lani mak ge.
4. Rei khou Eden pap zaeng ryanra rui
Zingmei rui kandi ta guam liam the
Tingkao neithan patpui Eden namthan gaimei tei
Alung khou hei ningtan makge.
Guang tang khang Zailou o, ]2
Phuna Ravguangc ta ai kaobam e.
